title: Govt to release consultation paper on AI regulation in a month, says Ashwini Vaishnaw
key_facts: Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said on 8 Oct 2026 that the government will release a consultation paper on AI regulation within a month.
The paper will form the basis of the country's approach to regulating AI, with a focus on safety and keeping humans at the centre.
It will also cover skilling, keeping AI-led change inclusive, the risks of deepfakes, and the possible psychological impact of AI.
Vaishnaw said deepfakes are improving every day, raising the risk that people are misled.
He said the bulk of the responsibility has to be on industry.
The government plans to move ahead with the regulatory process after taking inputs through the consultation.
quote_evidence: "Humanity has to be the most important part of this aspect," Vaishnaw said.
"The bulk of the responsibility has to be on industry," he said.
why_it_matters_hint: People exposed to deepfakes and AI-led job change, and the companies building AI, could see India's rules shaped by a public consultation.
